36547926.title: Sunset Bike Path
36547926.why_it_worked: handlebars+hand+duck anchor the lower third, proving a human is present; road converges on the sun so the frame has a single obvious subject

3c6ac74e.title: Wing Light
3c6ac74e.why_it_worked: the black window frame is a foreground mask that slides out as the plane banks, so the frame opens up rather than merely existing

3c6daa40.title: Ice Tilt
3c6daa40.why_it_worked: opens on boots with no horizon, so the 1-3s tilt-up is a genuine payoff rather than an establishing shot

832aea96.title: Sepia Deck
832aea96.why_it_worked: works only for an established audience; 0.15px/f reads as a photo on a cold feed

84c4fc6c.title: Monsoon Yard
84c4fc6c.why_it_worked: trees thrashing carry the hook with almost no camera work; motion in frame beats motion of camera

873baeeb.title: Fjord Wall
873baeeb.why_it_worked: near cliff sweeps past while far water barely moves; the parallax gives scale no static shot could

999364d3.title: Hemu Ridge
999364d3.why_it_worked: 18.5px/f tilt is 30x cruising speed, so the reveal lands hard; walkers backs-to-camera give a subject without a performer

aec75670.title: Cloud Tops
aec75670.why_it_worked: holds -0.44px/f for ten seconds without correction; the restraint is the aesthetic

d6b933be.title: Contrail Bank
d6b933be.why_it_worked: contrails give the sky horizontal structure so the drift is legible

e8aa2bda.title: Fire Highway
e8aa2bda.why_it_worked: highest saturation in the set; ordinary motorway under an impossible sky, and the contrast is the idea

dadb386c.title: Blue Willow
dadb386c.why_it_worked: camera is dead still; the gale in the willow is the entire hook. Proves camera motion is optional when the subject moves

b77487cb.title: Rotated Sunset
b77487cb.why_it_worked: horizon runs vertically so the viewer cannot parse the frame instantly; that confusion buys the first two seconds. Rotation is a post edit, not a camera move

d5824693.title: Rain Walk
d5824693.why_it_worked: front-loaded motion: -10deg/s whip at 0s then a push accelerating to +16%/s. Red tail-lights are the only saturated colour against sat 0.20
